strings.app.name: Cyber-Butler
strings.auth.lede: Sign in with an email code. Read status and send ordinary messages; delete, restore and reload actions never appear on the Web.
strings.auth.cardSub: The code is sent to the configured admin mailbox and is valid for 5 minutes.
strings.auth.finePrint: Only the pre-registered admin mailbox is accepted. A failed login does not reveal whether an email exists.
strings.auth.status.sent: If this mailbox is registered, the code has been sent.
strings.auth.error.sendFailed: Could not send the code. Please try again.
strings.auth.error.rate: Too many requests. Please try again later.
strings.auth.error.mailer: Could not send the code. Please try again.
strings.dash.lede: Read hardware, usage, plugins, logs and backups; chat is fixed to the owner and 苏瑾言 replies on QQ. High-risk actions never run on the Web.
strings.dash.temp.title: Temperature trend
strings.dash.temp.note: Sampled every 5 seconds; only the last 30 points in this page are kept.
strings.dash.status.title: System status
strings.dash.plugin.title: Plugins
strings.dash.log.title: Log tail
strings.dash.backup.title: Backups
strings.dash.backup.note: Names and sizes only; there is no restore, delete or download button.
strings.dash.security.pendingTitle: A high-risk action is waiting for approval
strings.dash.security.pendingNote: This page does not accept a verification code or provide an approve button.
strings.dash.security.note: Confirm in your mailbox or on the desktop.
strings.dash.link.title: Security note
strings.dash.link.text: The Web does not provide delete, restore, reload, persona, file-write or arbitrary-path access. Approve only in the mailbox or on the desktop.
strings.chat.title: Message 苏瑾言
strings.chat.meta: Fixed owner inbound · plain text · ≤500 chars · 5/minute
strings.chat.empty: Your messages appear here; 苏瑾言's reply goes to QQ.
strings.chat.sent: Sent. 苏瑾言 will reply on QQ.
strings.chat.error.notReady: Session not ready; refresh the page.
strings.chat.error.rate: Sending too often. Please try again later.
strings.chat.error.failed: Could not send. Please try again.
strings.files.title: My Big Fish files
strings.files.empty: This directory is empty, or its file types are hidden by policy.
strings.files.preview.tooLarge: This file is large; download it to view.
strings.files.preview.unsupported: This type cannot be previewed; use Download.
strings.files.note: This directory is read-only: no write, delete, upload, rename or restore API exists. Executable scripts and sensitive configuration are hidden.
strings.files.error.denied: That file or directory is not accessible.
strings.files.error.blocked: This file type is blocked by policy.
strings.error.403.title: Access denied
strings.error.403.message: This request was rejected by security policy.
strings.error.404.title: Page not found
strings.error.404.message: The page you requested could not be found.
strings.error.500.title: Service error
strings.error.500.message: The server could not complete the request.
